description: Persisted grants: <XDG_STATE_HOME>/<tool>/consent/grants.yaml, read through the file store together with the legacy telemetry record. `version` must be 1; each grant carries exactly capability, subject, decision, duration (until or always), decided_at, expires_at (until only, after decided_at), decision_source and prompt_version. `telemetry` may appear, any-subject and always only. A grants file that breaks any rule is malformed as a whole, so every check fails closed; the legacy config files are never consulted for other capabilities. Grants are listed sorted by capability, then subject (byte order).

cases.name: empty grant list
cases.grants_yaml:
version: 1
grants: []

cases.name: grants come back sorted by capability then subject
cases.grants_yaml:
version: 1
grants:
  - capability: io.screen.capture
    subject: app:dek
    decision: allow
    duration: always
    decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
    decision_source: prompt
    prompt_version: 1
  - capability: io.clipboard.read
    subject: app:dek
    decision: deny
    duration: always
    decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
    decision_source: prompt
    prompt_version: 1
  - capability: io.clipboard.read
    subject: ""
    decision: allow
    duration: until
    decided_at: "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"
    expires_at: "2026-03-02T00:00:00Z"
    decision_source: config
    prompt_version: 0

cases.grants_yaml: grants: []
